research_question: Do the two groups have different mean values?
hypothesis: The population means of groups A and B differ.
methodology: Pre-specify a two-sided Welch t-test at alpha 0.05, report the raw mean difference (A minus B) and 95% confidence interval. Inspect normality diagnostics descriptively without selecting a test based on their p-values.
assumptions: Observations are independent, measured on the same scale, and sampling supports the intended inference.
The included sample dataset is synthetic and illustrative.
limitations: An observational group comparison does not establish causality.
Small samples, skewness, outliers, and multiple testing require human review.
